title: Shared definitions
description: Ids, dates, references and status vocabularies every contract shares. Not an artifact itself.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case name (epic folder, runtime, engine, profile).

handle.description: A person or agent identity as the project writes it (a GitHub handle, an agent name).

docRef.description: A repository path with an optional #anchor (DECISIONS.md#ADR-0019), or a URL.

cujId.description: CUJ-<n>, scoped to one epic's cuj.md.

cujRef.description: CUJ-<n> in the citing artifact's own epic, or <epic>/CUJ-<n> across epics.

requirementId.description: REQ-<n> (functional) or NFR-<n> (non-functional), scoped to one epic's spec.md.

requirementRef.description: A requirement id in the citing artifact's own epic, or <epic>/REQ-<n> across epics.

qualifiedRequirementRef.description: <epic>/REQ-<n> or <epic>/NFR-<n>; used where the citing artifact belongs to no epic (an ADR).

taskStatus.description: Workflow status of a task; the kanban column. Mirrors state-machines/workflow.yaml (task machine).

epicStatus.description: Planning status of an epic (spec.md). Mirrors state-machines/workflow.yaml (epic machine).

attention.description: Runtime attention of a run or record. Never a workflow status (state-machines/attention.yaml).

mode.description: The methodology that selects skills and adds guards (playbook/methodology/modes.md). An epic's mode is the default for its tasks; a task's own mode overrides it. Not a runtime's engagement mode.

role.description: Workflow roles (state-machines/workflow.yaml). orchestrator acts only through a grant; reviewer comments on code, evaluator judges the criteria; neither commits a status.

budget.description: Ceilings for one run or one task. A runner enforces them; they are never advisory.

sessionRef.description: One agent session that worked a task, as the runtime names it.

outcome.description: As the run record says (run-record outcome): an evaluator's session ends in a verdict, a reader's in a read; neither advances the task.

traceGap.description: One finding of the trace check (validate.mjs --trace) and of a readiness report.

blocks_readiness.description: true when the epic cannot be ready while this gap exists, whatever its severity today.
